verified: F2 root cause confirmed: unresolved species falls to self.ids (aux counter from 1), Homo sapiens DB id 1 -> both id 1. PathWhiz keys @species_list by xml id (lib/pwml_parser.rb store_object hash[id]; add_content remaps species-id through it), so the later record won.

Skipping ids is safe for PathWhiz: xml ids are document-local (add_content skips the id node; DB rows found by taxonomy_id/attributes). All references go through remember()/lookup(), so shifts stay consistent. 134: species-id refs 10x1 + 1x4 unchanged; Mus musculus now 2; no reference pointed to it.

findings.what: Fix is species-only. Same collision class is latent for every other caller: cell types (:1143), subcellular locations (:1189), tissues (:1207), element collections (:1325), nucleic acids (:1354) share the aux counter from 1 with DB ids; compounds/proteins/complexes fall back to counters from 20000/30000/40000 that can equal a real PathBank id. PathWhiz keys each type by xml id, so a collision would silently re-point references. 0 observed in 97 replays (location ids 1-11, cell types 1-3, tissues 3-13, nucleic acids 8-35, all counter-made).
